TenancyNode.title: TenancyNode
TenancyNode.description: Immutable, content-addressed tenancy node: kind-prefixed opaque id, kind, display name, and the opaque id of the parent node (null only for the platform root).

TenancyRecordVersion.title: TenancyRecordVersion
TenancyRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized tenancy node, record, and snapshot (currently 1).

TenancyNodeId.title: TenancyNodeId
TenancyNodeId.description: Opaque, kind-prefixed tenancy node identity: one of the seven kind prefixes plus a lowercase slug.

TenancyNodeKind.title: TenancyNodeKind
TenancyNodeKind.description: Tenancy node kind: platform, tenant, workspace, project (organizational scopes) or world, scenario, evidence (project-local content).
